desc:
A custom Shopify app for one store adds the exact tool your business needs when no existing app does. Ecom Swift LLC builds private apps that sync orders, apply wholesale rules, print packing slips or tag customers, installed only on your store.

## What is a custom Shopify app for one store?

A custom app is software built for a single store rather than for the public App Store. It uses Shopify's Admin API to read and change store data, and it can add admin pages, scheduled jobs and webhook handlers. Because only your store installs it, there is no public listing and no marketplace review. You decide what it does, who can use it and when it changes.

## Why a private app can beat a public one

Public apps are built for many merchants, so they offer general settings and a general workflow. If your process is specific, you end up paying for features you do not use and still working around the gaps. A custom app does one job the way you do it.

Common examples are small and practical: copy new orders into a spreadsheet, apply a price rule for a wholesale customer group, create packing slips with your layout, or tag customers when they reach a certain order count. Each replaces a repeated manual task.

## How custom automation saves time and reduces errors

Manual work in an ecommerce store is slow and error-prone. Someone copies data between systems, forgets a step or applies a rule inconsistently. Automation does the same task the same way each time and leaves a record.

The benefit is mostly operational: staff spend less time on admin, fewer orders need correction and customers get consistent treatment. The savings depend on how often the task occurs, which is why we start by asking how many times a week it happens today.

## What a well-made custom store app includes

- A clear written description of the task and what counts as success.
- Admin API access with the smallest set of scopes the app needs.
- A simple settings page where your team can change the main options.
- An admin page for staff, with a dashboard where it helps.
- Webhook handling, so the app reacts as orders and customers change.
- Scheduled background jobs for work that should run on a timer.
- CSV import and export where staff work with files.
- Error alerts by email when something fails.
- A connection to an outside service, if the process needs one.

## How we build it

We agree the process in writing, then build the app in your own account and install it on your store. We test on a draft or development store before running it on live data, and we explain how the app runs, where it is hosted and how to update it. Because the code is yours, another developer can maintain it later.

The Basic package covers one small automation or admin tool. Standard adds a second feature, an admin page, a scheduled job, webhook handling and email alerts. Premium delivers a fuller private app with a dashboard, exports, an outside connection and a handover call, with a period of fixes afterwards. Hosting costs, if any, are paid by you directly to the host.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Describe the manual task step by step, with examples.
- Decide who on your team will use the app.
- Keep the first version small and add features later.
- Ask us to explain how the app is hosted and updated.

**Avoid:**
- Requesting broad permissions that the task does not need.
- Automating a process that is still changing every week.
- Storing sensitive data in the app without a reason.
- Building a custom app for something a simple setting already does.

## Who this service is for

Store owners with a repeated manual task and no suitable app. Wholesale sellers with price or order rules that standard tools cannot express. Operations managers who want reports, exports or labels in their own format.

## What we need from you

A step-by-step description of the task, sample data, and staff or collaborator access to your store so we can create and install the app. We never ask for passwords. If an outside service is involved, we need a test account for it.
